feeds.title: Prison Fellowship » Advocacy & Reentry
feeds.description: Founded in 1976, Prison Fellowship is a Christian non-profit organization that aims to provide support, education, and advocacy for prisoners and their families. The Advocacy & Reentry blog section focuses on policy and advocacy efforts to improve the reentry process for individuals leaving prison.

feeds.title: TPOM Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2015, TPOM (The Prison Outreach Ministry) is a Christian organization that provides support and resources to incarcerated individuals and their families. The blog section features personal stories and reflections on the challenges and opportunities of reentry.

feeds.title: Concord Prison Outreach Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1977, Concord Prison Outreach is a non-profit organization that provides support and resources for individuals and families impacted by incarceration in Massachusetts. The blog section features personal stories, updates on events and programs, and reflections on issues related to reentry.

feeds.title: Living Beyond the Bars Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2013, Living Beyond the Bars is a non-profit organization that provides support and resources for individuals and families impacted by the criminal justice system in Connecticut. The blog section features personal stories, reflections, and resources related to reentry and community engagement.

feeds.title: Bridges Reetry Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2015, Bridges Reentry is a non-profit organization that provides support and resources for individuals reentering society after incarceration in Utah. The blog section features personal stories, updates on programs and services, and resources related to employment, housing, and education.

feeds.title: GEO Reentry Connect Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Geo Reentry Connect blog, dedicated to supporting successful reentry and empowering individuals as they reintegrate into their communities. Our experts provide valuable insights, resources, and stories to guide individuals, families, and professionals in the field.

feeds.title: Reentry Lifeskills Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2013, Reentry Lifeskills is a non-profit organization that provides resources and training for individuals reentering society after incarceration. The blog section features articles and resources on topics such as job searching, financial planning, and community engagement.

feeds.title: Safe & Just Michigan » Reentry
feeds.description: Founded in 2003, Safe & Just Michigan is a non-profit organization that advocates for criminal justice reform in Michigan. The Reentry blog section features news and updates on policy efforts and resources for individuals reentering society after incarceration.
